name: KineticType
description: Expressive kinetic typography engine where words and characters animate with coordinated rotation, scale, optical blur, and 3D position trajectories across four presets.
a11yNotes: Exposes the full unsplit sentence via aria-label on the semantic heading while marking animated glyph wrappers aria-hidden='true'. Renders static text immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

defaultProps.text: Choreographed kinetic typography for precision interfaces

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Headline or display copy to animate.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay in seconds between consecutive tokens.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Animation duration per token in seconds.

propsApi.name: blurStrength
propsApi.description: Initial Gaussian blur radius in pixels.
